body:
This was my first time with Salvia.
I decided to try it for the first time alone (risky?). So I started smoking a small quantity (about 50 mg) with no result. I repeated it  until the quantity raised up to about 150 mg. Wow....!!!!
My head got heavy and my room started to transform into a place with olive trees and I was standing in a sand road. I was (with no particular reason) so happy that I cannot describe it and started laughting really loud (I believe so)...
After some minutes when I was back to real world I was so amazed of this experience that I tried it again with a slightly larger quantity.
This time my room started to melt like a Salvador Dali's painting and transformed into something like a beach with trees (not in a pure solid state). The water seemed to be on a different layer (something like a blanket on a bed) than the ground and was trying to cover me.
I have never been so happy before. I though that maybe I was in paradise!!!!!
